boundary_path_Nempty_controls.N1_unproved_empty_support_cases: One incidence equals5: that root has no external side factor. This strengthening gives no outside z-w path.

boundary_path_Nempty_controls.strengthened_hypothesis: An external z-w path in G-P suffices for N-empty when N_B(P)=empty; the path may pass through B. H-P connected is sufficient, not necessary.

complete_same_graph_relation_schema.complete_relation: R_P(beta)={(f(x)) for x in ordered distinct original contacts: f colors every vertex of original P and every actual P-B edge against the literal beta}
complete_same_graph_relation_schema.exact_complete_join: J_G(beta)=(A_z(beta) x A_w(beta)) intersection every J_Cj(beta)
complete_same_graph_relation_schema.full_same_graph_lift: Each tuple carries its whole original-P coloring; a shared contact occurs once.
complete_same_graph_relation_schema.root_fibre: R_P(beta;a,b) is the subset of complete tuples avoiding a at all original z-contacts and b at all original w-contacts; absent values are UNKNOWN, never empty by default.
complete_same_graph_relation_schema.side_available_colors: A_r(beta)={a: all actual root-spokes avoid a and every original unary factor has a whole original tuple avoiding a at all its r-contacts}
complete_same_graph_relation_schema.triple_criticality: For each original nonframe edge e retain a full coloring of G-e extending a row in indices1/4/6, including all original attachments and one literal shared color frame.

noncritical_derivative_E2_interface.double_unit_side_or_unit_mixed_deletion: When both roots lose one incidence, X has epsilon0; omitted complete degree-four pieces contribute zero.
noncritical_derivative_E2_interface.hypotheses: X is a disk subgraph retaining B, accepts all T4, every effective private degree>=4, epsilon(X)<=1. X need not itself be Sigma-critical.
noncritical_derivative_E2_interface.original_unit_side_deletion: X=G-f has epsilon1 for an original root-spoke or capacity-one unary factor.
noncritical_derivative_E2_interface.proof_dependency: Select a Sigma-preserving minimal Y. Its degree floor gives epsilon(Y)<=epsilon(X); use E2 on Y. This is a paper argument, not established by mask enumeration.

quotient_face_controls.paper_claim: For every plane K(2,m), m>=2: V=m+2,E=2m,F=m; all faces have length4 and exactly two mixed vertices. A connected disjoint B occupies one face.
quotient_face_controls.scope: Fixed quotient rotation controls; full original pieces are never replaced in coloring relations.
